chunks: Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhari narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah عليه السلام about a man who looked in upon a group of people in order to see their private parts, and they struck him, killing him, wounding him, or gouging out his eye. So he said:

There is no blood money for him. A man once peeped into the room of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله through an opening in it, so the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله came to him with a broad arrowhead to gouge out his eye with it, but found that he had already gone away. Then he called out to him: 'O wicked one, had you remained for me, I would have gouged out your eye with it.'

key_terms.بِمِشْقَصٍ: with a broad arrowhead or sharp pointed instrument
key_terms.دِيَةَ: blood money or legal financial compensation for injury or killing
key_terms.عَوْرَاتِهِمْ: their private parts or private bodily nakedness
key_terms.لِيَفْقَأَ: to gouge out, specifically the eye
key_terms.مِنْ خِلَالِهَا: through an opening or gap in it

ai.seo_question: Is there blood money for someone injured while spying on people’s private parts?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who intrudes upon people in order to look at their private parts: if he is injured or even killed while being repelled, there is no diyyah for him. The Imam عليه السلام supports this ruling by citing the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, showing the gravity of violating others’ privacy and sanctity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5183 - Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Jawhari narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who spies on a group of people to look at their private matters, and they strike him, killing him, injuring him, or gouging out his eye.
Imam (as) said: "There is no blood money (diyyah) for him. The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) once had a man peep into his room through a crack, so the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) approached him with an arrowhead to gouge out his eye, but he found that the man had left.
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) then called out to him, saying: 'O' wicked one! Had you remained there, I would have gouged out your eye with it.'"
